title: When an enemy attacks from behind, the spear gets there first. What do you think of this combat animation?
author: kent18730
selftext:
I’ve been refining the combat system for my first indie game, A Life Forged.  
This move is inspired by the traditional Chinese spear technique known as the “turn-back spear” (回马枪).  
I want every combat animation to have a purpose, not just look flashy. Footwork, momentum, timing, and positioning should all tell a story.  
The game is a medieval fantasy life-simulation RPG where your choices shape your relationships, abilities, battles, and fate. Death isn’t the end — it’s the beginning of another life.  
I’m developing it solo with the help of AI tools.  
This is actual in-game combat footage, not a cinematic trailer.  
What do you think of the movement, impact, and combat flow? I’d love some constructive feedback.  
Free browser demo:  
https://evan730.itch.io/gamelife
